rules.trigger: Person puts the phone on the desk or Person sits at the desk
rules.action: Pick up the book and place it next to the person.

rules.trigger: Person opens the book or Person reads the book
rules.action: Pick up the mug and place it next to the person.

rules.trigger: Person closes the book or Person stands up from the desk
rules.action: Pick up the mug and place it in the dishwasher.

rules.trigger: Person closes the book or Person returns to the desk
rules.action: Pick up the laptop and place it next to the person.

rules.trigger: Person closes the book or Person returns to the desk
rules.action: Pick up the can and place it next to the person.

rules.trigger: Person closes the laptop or Person stands up from the desk
rules.action: Pick up the can and place it in the trash can.

rules.trigger: Person walks towards the light switch or Person stands near the light switch
Person puts the phone on the bed or Person places the phone on the bedside table
